notes.title: v0.6 - UI Update
notes.notes:
The version 0.6 of the game is now live.
UI and HUD has been completely redone in this update, focusing on clearer information.
The update also include some new gore effects and a lot of other little improvements.


A lot of things still have to be done, see you on the next update !
